caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, square-shaped composition with a central floral motif. The innermost section is a flower with eight rounded petals, each colored in deep purple with lighter highlights, and outlined in a peach or light orange hue. The center of the flower is circular and matches the petal outlines in color. This flower sits inside a square frame that is shaded in a mix of brown and peach hues. The space between the flower and this frame is filled with a light blue color. Surrounding the square is a broader, scalloped border in green, resembling rounded leaves or foliage. At each of the four corners of the green scalloped square, there is a purple, triangular or arrowhead-like accent pointing outward, giving the design a slightly extended cross shape. The square and its borders sit on a pale, mottled background with hints of gray, beige, and very light purple, suggesting a stone or textured surface. The overall color palette consists predominantly of green, blue, purple, peach, brown, and hints of beige.
title: Ceiling Ornament, Sandstone
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
